description: GAP-2 (bean qou-rbfr, epic qou-xu6t): whether the winding parity behind the merged #4401 sign mechanism can be READ OFF the Gröbner–Shirshov reduction certificate of a braid word rather than asserted from its w^n presentation (w = σ₁σ₂⁻¹, 4₁ = w², Borromean = w³). Two gradings answer differently. COXETER grading: the image of w^n in S₃ is (s₁s₂)ⁿ with s₁s₂ a 3-cycle, so the permutation support / grade profile is periodic with period 3 — it sees n mod 3 and is blind to the parity. q-GRADING: the certificate's total coefficient sum is a Laurent polynomial of degree exactly 2n−1 with leading coefficient exactly (−1)ⁿ — the winding parity, verified n = 1..8. MARKOV: that readout is FRAMED, not yet a knot invariant — unchanged under positive stabilisation, multiplied by (1−h) under negative stabilisation (h = q−q⁻¹); harmless on the canonical family because w^n has exponent sum 0, but a general braid needs writhe-normalisation first. PARTIAL WIRE, reported as such: converts the parity from presentation-asserted to certificate-derived and identifies which grading carries it, but does not deliver the full winding class (m,ℓ), and is verified on the zero-writhe canonical family only. No Δ_λ, no c_k, no magnitude, nothing wired.

wire_readout.coxeter_layer: image of w^n in S₃ = (s₁s₂)ⁿ, period 3 ⇒ sees n mod 3, parity-blind
wire_readout.q_layer: Σ_w c_w(q) has degree 2n−1, leading coefficient (−1)ⁿ (n = 1..8)
wire_readout.markov_negative_stabilisation: coefficient sum × (1 − h), h = q − q⁻¹
wire_readout.canonical_family_writhe: exponent sum of w^n = 0 for all n (no correction needed)
wire_readout.verdict: PARTIAL WIRE — parity is certificate-derivable via the q-grading (not the Coxeter grading), as a framed quantity stable on the zero-writhe canonical family; full (m,ℓ) still open, general-braid case needs writhe normalisation
